name: Data Analysis
description: Tables, numbers and charts: cleaning, calculating, summarising.
note: This is a data analysis project. State where each number comes from, never alter the source data (work on copies), show how a figure was calculated, and mention rows or values that were dropped or look wrong.
verify: recompute a sample by hand; the Data tools
details: Tables, numbers and charts. The agent says where each number comes from, never changes your source data (it works on copies), shows how a figure was calculated, and recomputes a sample by hand to check itself. The Data tools do the work on CSV files: describe every column, ask a question in SQL, count the most frequent values, draw a bar, line, scatter or histogram chart, and turn a spreadsheet into CSV. Nothing is sent anywhere and your file is never changed.
examples: Clean a messy CSV export and summarise it by month
Which customers account for 80 percent of sales?
A chart of a year of measurements

tools.why: SQL over a CSV file, summaries and charts
